verdict.rationale: Stripe Connect has a dedicated testing guide for exercising account creation, identity verification and payouts before going live, which implies a pre-production test environment. The pack contains only that one thin mention, though. It never explicitly describes a sandbox or test mode, test API keys, or data isolation from live accounts. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an isolated sandbox/test mode with separate keys and data, details on agent or CLI-driven test workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
